senses.gloss: उमा f. 1. A name of Pārvatī (in this sense the word is thus derived by Kālidāsa, probably on the authority of the Kālikā and Śiva Purāṇas- उ मेति मात्रा तपसो निषिद्धा पश्चादुमाख्यं सुमुखी जगाम K.S.i.26), उमावृषांकौ शरजन्मना यथा R.iii.23, K.S.iii.67; 2. light, splendour; 3. fame, reputation; 4. tranquility; 5. turmeric.
उमा-पति m. an epithet of Śiva, मुहुरनुस्मरयंतमनुक्षपं त्रिपुरदाहमुमापतिसेविनः Kir.v.14.
उमा-सहाय m. an epithet of Śiva.
उमा-सुत m. 1. an epithet of Kārtikeya; 2. of Gaṇeśa.
